items.briefing:
Australian organisations are rapidly adopting AI tools, but today's reporting highlights a growing gap between enthusiasm and caution. Local executives continue to trust AI systems despite known audit errors, and businesses are deploying AI agents faster than proper governance frameworks can keep up. Separately, a vulnerability in the OpenClaw AI platform could allow attackers to manipulate AI model outputs — a reminder that AI tools themselves can be compromised.

Before accepting AI-generated reports or decisions at face value, verify outputs against trusted sources. **Tip:** Establish a simple human sign-off process for any AI-generated content used in compliance, finance, or student records.

featured.title: Australian enterprises are scaling agents faster than governance - MCP is the fix
featured.summary: Governance gaps are slowing enterprise AI adoption, with 79% of Australian DevSecOps professionals saying compliance is getting harder.
